data.narrative:
Porotech is a Series A-stage semiconductor company founded by Tongtong Zhu, Yingjun Liu, and Rachel Oliver, having raised $20M+ to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector includes 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers (including SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, PsiQuantum, and Etched), though a sufficiently narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier is not available for reliable peer-median analysis.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology is the sole applicable triangulation approach. Using the $20M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to subsequent stage, this method implies a valuation of $40M. Public semiconductor comparables trade at a median P/S multiple of 21.4x (across ALAB, NVDA, AMD), but without disclosed revenue for Porotech, this anchor cannot be operationalized.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $34M to $46M, with a median point of $40M. This estimate carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of narrow private peer data. Revenue disclosure or a more granular peer set at similar stage and capital efficiency would materially sharpen conviction in this range.
